BiblicalUsage: Machol is the dance, the round dance of rejoicing, and it turns up where mourning turns to joy. Psalms 30:11 says God turned mourning into dancing, and Jeremiah 31:13 says the virgin shall rejoice in the dance, young men and old together, because God will turn their mourning into joy. Psalms 149:3 puts the dance in worship itself: let them praise His name in the dance, with timbrel and harp.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the dance in these verses is not entertainment but testimony: a body that was bowed in grief standing up to praise. My position is that Psalms 30:11 is the pattern of the Christian life, mourning turned into dancing by the God who does the turning.
